kjv: I (Yahweh) will destroy and devour at once
note: Hebrew 'eshshom we'esh'aph continues the labour image: "I will gasp (nasham, breathe hard) and pant (sha'aph)"; the KJV derived the verbs from shamem "lay waste" and sha'aph "swallow".
Hebrew meshullam (pual of shalam) is "one in covenant of peace / devoted", a title for the servant Israel; "perfect" implies moral flawlessness.
